steps.prompt: Add a module docstring to export.py. The data team says: exports use ';' as the field separator. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.

Add a return type hint to sep_default() in export.py. The data team has changed the format: exports now use the pipe character '|' as the field separator, replacing the earlier one. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.
Implement to_line(fields) in export.py: join the given string fields into one export line with the project's field separator, no quoting and no trailing newline.
